config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND opened_for='611';

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND status='closed_complete';

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND worknotes IS NOT NULL AND worknotes != '';

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND worknotes LIKE '%' || number || '%';

description: New case worknotes has a resolution summary of meaningful length

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND LENGTH(worknotes) > 20;

description: Single new case satisfies all core fields together

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case WHERE short_description='Contractor to FTE conversion for Daniel Foster' AND opened_for='610' AND opened_by='501' AND assigned_to='501' AND priority='moderate' AND hr_service=(SELECT hr_service_id FROM hr_service WHERE service_name='employee conversion') AND status='closed_complete';

description: Acting admin Maya 501 remains admin

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_id='501' AND role='admin' AND email='maya.rodriguez@globex.com';

description: Welcome message addressed to correct corporate email daniel.foster@globex.com

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='user_maya_rodriguez' AND mh.name='To' AND mh.value='daniel.foster@globex.com'

description: Welcome message with correct subject and recipient sent from Maya's own mailbox

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_labels ml ON ml.message_id=m.id JOIN labels l ON l.id=ml.label_id WHERE m.user_id='user_maya_rodriguez' AND l.name IN ('Sent','SENT')

description: Welcome message carries the Sent label under Maya's mailbox

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_labels ml ON ml.message_id=m.id JOIN labels l ON l.id=ml.label_id WHERE m.user_id='user_maya_rodriguez' AND l.name IN ('Sent','SENT')

description: No welcome message sent from a mailbox other than Maya's

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE mh.name='Subject' AND mh.value='Welcome to Globex Daniel Foster' AND m.user_id != 'user_maya_rodriguez';

description: Welcome message must NOT be addressed to decoy d.foster@globex.com

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers mh JOIN message_parts mp ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id JOIN messages m ON mp.message_id=m.id WHERE m.user_id='user_maya_rodriguez' AND mh.name='To' AND mh.value LIKE '%d.foster@globex.com%' AND mh.value NOT LIKE '%daniel.foster@globex.com%';
